description: Class activation maps (Grad-CAM, Score-CAM, LeGrad and more) for PyTorch CNNs and Vision Transformers
rules: Call model.eval() first and run CAM extraction outside torch.no_grad() and torch.inference_mode(); gradient-based methods need autograd.
To debug one 2D image prediction, use torchcam.explain.explain(model, input_tensor, expected_class_idx=..., class_names=...) and save its bundle.
Use extractors as context managers (with GradCAM(model) as extractor:) so hooks are removed afterwards.
Wrap models returning tuples, dictionaries or Hugging Face outputs so that forward returns the logits tensor.
For torchvision ViTs use LeGrad with list(model.encoder.layers)[-4:]; other transformers need target_layer and reshape_transform.
CAMs show class-associated activation; do not present them as causal explanations or proofs of correctness.
